stem:
A student measures the heights of some pea plants in inches. The dot plot shows his data.

Pea Plants

Each ● represents 1 pea plant.

Which list represents the heights of the pea plants in inches?
visual_elements: dot plot with x-axis labeled 2 to 7 showing pea plant heights with counts: 2(1 dot), 3(1 dot), 4(4 dots), 5(3 dots), 6(2 dots), 7(1 dot)
difficulty_rationale: Requires interpreting a dot plot, counting the number of dots for each height, then listing those numbers correctly.
